03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill for maintaining Swami's Fusion AI Rules: good-practice rules for AIs that model in Autodesk Fusion. The public GitHub repository swami-claude-skills/fusion-ai-rules is the single source of truth, with one YAML file per rule.

Swami asks for a change in plain words. Claude edits the files on a branch, runs the build checks, picks the version bump, updates the change log and page text, and opens a pull request. Swami approves the merge, and GitHub then builds the exports, the GitHub Pages site and the release by itself.

Why it mattersThe rules are used by several AIs and by other people. Keeping them in one repository with a fixed process means every change is reviewed, versioned and exported the same way, and nobody has to remember the steps.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Rule EditsAdds a new rule as rules/R##-slug.yaml, or changes one, in the existing field order. Rule IDs are permanent and never reused.
  • VersioningBumps ruleset.yaml: patch for a wording fix, minor for a new rule or export target, major for a rule removed or deprecated, a meaning changed, or a priority raised to Must.
  • DeprecationNever deletes a rule: marks it Deprecated and points to the replacement, which lists it under supersedes.
  • ConflictsClears conflicts_with between active rules, since the build check fails while two active rules name each other.
  • CandidatesPromotes accepted candidates from candidates/ to rules/ under their proposed IDs, records the decisions in sources/, and checks the author has agreed to CC BY 4.0.
  • Build CheckRuns python3 build/build.py check and build, and reports any export target that falls back to a smaller selection or titles only.
  • TestsAdds a test question for each new rule in tests/prompts/, turns results from the Test result form into tests/results/ files, and changes a rule's status only when the results back it.
  • Page and AudioUpdates the Rule Set page text and its spoken overview when the rule count or meaning changes, re-recording with the vibe-dashboard skill.
  • Pull RequestScans for private details, pushes a branch, opens a pull request through the GitHub REST API with the repository's template, and watches it.
  • RepublishAfter the merge, checks the Action and Pages deploy, then rebuilds Swami's Claude copy of the Rule Set page with its private links and republishes it.
  • Admin PageRefreshes Swami's private Rules Admin page after rules or results change, running vibe-dashboard's current patches on it (table-fit, Search and Mind Map, then visuals, toolbar, source colour, source view and tooltips) so it keeps the house style.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Safe ChangesEvery change goes through a branch, a passing build check and a pull request, so main never breaks.
  • Clear VersionsPicks the version bump from the kind of change, so a release number tells readers how big the change is.
  • Hands-Off PublishingExports for all AIs, the public site and the release are rebuilt automatically from the merged files.
  • No Self-MergeClaude never merges without Swami's own go-ahead; a GitHub comment can't authorize it.
  • Blocked APIsGitHub's GraphQL API, Pages settings and branch protection settings are blocked from Claude sessions, so it uses the REST API and Swami changes settings himself.
  • No Live Site CheckThe github.io site can't be opened from Claude's workspace; deploys are checked through the GitHub deployments API instead.
09Scheduled TasksRUNTIME▶

None. It runs when Swami asks for a rule change or a review. The repository's GitHub Action builds and publishes on every merge, but that is GitHub, not a Claude scheduled task.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Never DeleteDeleting a rule file breaks links and history. Deprecate it instead.
  • Private Fileprivate.json holds the private links for the Claude copy. It lives only in project files and must never be committed.
  • Size LimitsLong rules push size-limited export targets down to Must only or titles only. The build allows it, but say so in the pull request.
  • No Test PushesNever test branch protection by pushing to main; it records a commit that can't be cleanly removed.
12Other RequirementsREFERENCE▶
  • GitHub AccessSwami's GitHub connected to Claude, with the fusion-ai-rules repository attached with push access.
  • ProjectThe Fusion AI Rules Claude project, for private.json and project memory.
  • WindowsNothing extra: works the same from Windows 10 or 11.

DeprecatedRulesA rule that is retired but kept, pointing to the rule that replaces it.
